context: Two coworkers review shipping logistics issues
purpose: Teach: 工作/発送/送料/到達/定価/稼ぎ/先物/付属

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 今週の発送業務、ちょっと問題が多くて頭が痛いんですよね。
lines.en: This week's shipping operations have so many problems, it's giving me a headache.
lines.style: Tired professional venting with polite resignation tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ああ、聞きましたよ。送料無料キャンペーンの影響で注文が殺到してるって。
lines.en: Ah, I heard. Orders are flooding in because of the free shipping campaign.
lines.style: Sympathetic colleague acknowledging the workload pressure casually.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: そうなんです。しかも倉庫の梱包作業が追いつかなくて、出荷が遅れてます。
lines.en: Exactly. And the warehouse packing work can't keep up, so shipments are delayed.
lines.style: Frustrated explanation with concrete operational details listed clearly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 九州方面の荷物、予定日に届いてないって苦情も入ってましたよね。
lines.en: There were also complaints that Kyushu-bound packages aren't arriving on schedule.
lines.style: Concerned colleague raising specific customer feedback formally.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい。配送ルートの最終到達地点まで確認したら、中継所で止まってました。
lines.en: Yes. When I checked the final delivery destination on the route, packages were stuck at the transit hub.
lines.style: Investigative tone reporting concrete findings from logistics tracking.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: それに定価より高く転売されてる商品もあるみたいで、本当に厄介ですよね。
lines.en: Plus some items are apparently being resold above list price, which is really troublesome.
lines.style: Concerned colleague acknowledging additional compounding market problems.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 転売ヤーは差額で稼ぎたいだけなんですけど、先物みたいに在庫を抱え込まれると本当に困ります。
lines.en: Resellers just want to earn the price difference, but when they hoard stock like futures contracts it's really a problem.
lines.style: Frustrated explanation comparing reseller stockpiling to commodity hoarding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: あと、付属品が一部欠けてるって報告も来てて、検品の工作精度も見直さないとですね。
lines.en: Also, there are reports of missing accessories, so we need to revise the precision of our inspection work too.
lines.style: Methodical colleague outlining quality control priorities thoroughly.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 了解です。明日の朝一で物流チームと対策会議を設定しておきますね。
lines.en: Understood. I'll schedule a countermeasure meeting with the logistics team first thing tomorrow.
lines.style: Decisive professional taking initiative with reassuring practical commitment.
